DIAGNOSIS READY: Vasovagal syncope (micturition syncope)

The clinical picture of loss of consciousness immediately after urination, rapid recovery without confusion, and no injury strongly points to a reflex vasovagal event triggered by the Valsalva maneuver and blood pooling in the bladder, rather than a urinary tract infection.
